detailZones.title: Pepper, cucumber and lemon
detailZones.description: A red bell pepper, a whole cucumber and half a lemon rest together on a low plate. The cut lemon shows a ring of white pith around its juicy segments.

detailZones.title: Salad and a packed sandwich
detailZones.description: Two clear lunch boxes sit side by side. One holds mixed salad with halved tomatoes and white cheese, and the other holds a sandwich with a folded slice of deli meat.

detailZones.title: Eggs and yogurt
detailZones.description: A clear tub of plain yogurt stands beside brown eggs in a molded carton. The lid and the individual egg cups are visible.

detailZones.title: Box of carrot sticks
detailZones.description: Orange carrot sticks lie in different directions inside a clear box. A green locking tab folds over the front of the lid.

detailZones.title: Grain salad and juice
detailZones.description: Tiny grains, green herbs and orange vegetable pieces can be seen through a blue-lidded box. The bottle on the right holds a bright orange drink.

detailZones.title: Pasta and cut fruit
detailZones.description: A pasta lunch with spirals, a dark olive and tomato pieces sits beside a box of cut pineapple and round blueberries.

detailZones.title: Tomatoes, spinach and milk
detailZones.description: Cherry tomatoes and spinach leaves fill separate boxes. A tall bottle of milk stands on the right, with its blue screw cap in view.

detailZones.title: Apples in the crisper
detailZones.description: Red apples and green apples sit behind the transparent drawer front. Some still have stems and faint streaks on the skin.

detailZones.title: Pickles and condiments
detailZones.description: The upper door bin holds pickles in brine, coarse mustard and two squeeze bottles. Its clear front lets the jars show through.

detailZones.title: Drinks and pickled onions
detailZones.description: A water bottle, two small drinks and a jar of pink onion rings stand behind the rail of the middle door bin.

detailZones.title: Olives, chili flakes and dip
detailZones.description: Green olives and red chili flakes are packed into jars on the bottom door shelf. A round covered tub holds a pale dip.

detailZones.title: Light and glass shelf
detailZones.description: An oblong light shines above the food. A narrow glass shelf stretches across the refrigerator on white side supports.

anchorAudit.rationale: The photograph resolves individual foods, containers, shelf fittings and door bins. Each point was checked on the final image. Storage instructions and time limits are available in the word index.
